causal_scenarios.alternative_cause: The depots that adopted the scanners are the same ones that replaced their pallet racking that quarter, under a single capital programme.
causal_scenarios.reverse_causation: The rollout went first to the depots with the cleanest damage records, on the reasoning that those crews would be quickest to retrain.
causal_scenarios.sampling_flaw: The figures come from the six depots that opted into the pilot, all of which volunteered for it.
inert_facts: The handheld scanners were leased rather than purchased outright, under the same framework agreement the network uses for its vehicles.
Damage is recorded by the receiving depot rather than the sending one, which has been the network's practice since it was founded.
Freight volumes across the network were broadly flat that quarter, as they have been in the equivalent quarter for several years.
The network circulates its damage figures to every contracted carrier each month, in a report whose format has not changed.
causal_scenarios.control_comparison: Depots of similar size that did not adopt the scanners recorded no change in damage over the same quarter.

ratio_scenarios.base_change: The depot handled roughly five times as many scheduled deliveries last year as in its opening year.
inert_facts: The depot added a second loading bay between the two years.
Lateness is measured against the carrier's published window.
The network uses the same definition of lateness at every depot.
The network's published delivery window is the same at every depot.
